 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u000/system/state/workspace/programs/task-1105f100.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Duplicate source cell multiset into four quadrants; for non-original
    # quadrants, use a deterministic shuffle derived from the grid content.
    import random
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    flat = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    out = [row[:] + [0]*w for row in grid] + [[0]*(2*w) for _ in range(h)]
    rng = random.Random(repr(tuple(map(tuple, grid))))
    for qy in range(2):
        for qx in range(2):
            if qy == 0 and qx == 0:
                continue
            cells = flat[:]
            rng.shuffle(cells)
            for i, value in enumerate(cells):
                out[qy*h + i//w][qx*w + i%w] = value
    return out
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
